newsitem.title: UK: UK may turn to City for transport funds-paper.
newsitem.headline: UK may turn to City for transport funds-paper.

text.p: Britain's Deputy Prime Minister and transport head John Prescott may turn to London's financial community to raise up to two billion stg through a special bond issue to fund repairs to London Transport, the Times said on Monday.
The newspaper quoted a spokeman for the Department of Transport as saying: "The government is looking at all options."
One alternative was that investment banks in London could issue bonds. Another was that London Transport could operate a trust through which public and private funding was channelled, the paper said.
